- NEW AlgebraicJacobian/RiemannRoch/Ledger/UniformRiemannRoch.lean (385 lines, 0 sorries)
- NEW scripts/ajcrr-uniformriemannroch-axioms.lean (167 lines, axiom probe)
- ExtensionUniformity.lean and P1Vanishing.lean: docstring rewraps only (long-line lint fixes), declaration lines byte-identical.

MY CLAIMS, WHICH I WANT YOU TO TRY TO REFUTE. Be adversarial; this lane has shipped false or overstated claims in five previous rounds and I would rather you find them than a later session.

1. "Cluster-P item 3 (global generation) had NO extension-uniform statement in AJC before this file, and `UniformGeneration` is the first." Check whether some other AJC file already states uniform generation under a different name (e.g. Adelic/GlobalGeneration.lean, Adelic/UniformChartVanishing.lean, Adelic/ResidueField.lean's `UniformlyBoundedVanishing`, `exists_bound_forall_generatedAt`). If any of those already quantifies generation over field extensions, my headline is wrong.

2. "Uniform generation reduces to the SAME single open input `UniformBaseDivisor C d` as uniform vanishing, with the SAME threshold `d + genus C`." Verify by reading `uniformGeneration_of_uniformBaseDivisor` that it really takes only `UniformBaseDivisor C d` plus curve instance binders, and that no extra hypothesis crept into the `UniformGeneration` definition that makes the conclusion weaker than the single-field `exists_bound_generated_curve`. In particular: is `UniformGeneration` actually STRONGER than instantiating the single-field statement at each C_kappa, or accidentally the same thing? (The analogous check for vanishing is `vanishing_baseChangeField_of_uniformVanishing` in ExtensionUniformity.lean.)

3. "FiberBound has curve forms only for vanishing and the h0 formula; section-drop and generation were only stated with `pi` as an argument, so my `exists_bound_section_drop_curve` / `exists_bound_generated_curve` were genuinely missing." Verify no other file already had those curve forms.

4. "The residue is unchanged: `UniformBaseDivisor C d` is still open for genus >= 1." Confirm I did not accidentally claim to close it anywhere in the new file's prose, and that my docstrings keep the three cluster-P statements (single-field vanishing / extension-uniformity / global generation) precisely apart. The task brief says conflating those three is the specific error the task exists to avoid.

5. "Not portable from AJCR, measured": I claim UniformBaseDivisor/UniformGeneration/UniformSectionDrop/UniformRiemannRoch occur ZERO times in Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild, and that the only `Function.Surjective (Sheaf.HModule.map ...)` in AJCR is SectionBound.lean:74 (the peel `.f 1`, not the evaluation `.g 0`). Re-measure both.

6. PHANTOM NAMES: every declaration name cited in the new file's docstrings should exist. My probe prints axioms for the cited names and elaborated with exit 0, but check the docstrings for names NOT covered by the probe.

VERIFICATION I ALREADY HAVE: `lake build AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.UniformRiemannRoch` = 8728 jobs, EXIT=0, "Build completed successfully", zero errors, three pre-existing Picard/ sorry warnings (QuotFunctorDef x2, FGAPicRepresentability). Axiom probe exit 0, 40 declarations all `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` including 6 synthesis sites at `Adelic.p1Over (ULift ℚ)`, both controls firing sorryAx.

ALSO CHECK: whether roadmap item AJC.rr.extuniform's summary is now stale given this commit (I added a comment but did not rewrite the summary), and whether I-0819 (the axiom-frontier §6b staleness issue I filed) is accurate.

DO NOT EDIT SOURCE. Report findings; I will reconcile them. Note: a full `lake build` takes ~40 min under current machine load, so prefer reading source and using targeted greps/searches over rebuilding.
